problem:
$$
V=\text{Span}{[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 5 \\ -4\end{aligned}]},\,B={[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}a \\ b \\ c\end{aligned}]}
$$

Consider the subspace $V$ and an orthogonal basis $B$ of $V,$ given above. Given that $B$ is derived from $V$ using the Gram-Schmidt process, what is the value of $\frac{c}{b}?$
